Package shape

Class Shape

java.lang.Object
shape.Shape
Direct Known Subclasses:
Circle, Curve, Line, Point, Polygon, Rectangle, Square
public abstract class Shape extends Object
Abstract base class for all drawable shapes. Contains common rendering attributes and line-segment drawing helper.
